svg.aria-label: Pulsar Code: a pulsar ignites and lights the PULSAR CODE wordmark; a readout shows a masked key prefix (or a local engine's name) detected as its provider and routed through Pulsar Core on 127.0.0.1
svg.title: Pulsar Code
svg.desc: A pulsar beside the PULSAR CODE wordmark; its two beams turn at the speeds the terminal uses (5.03 s and 6.61 s per turn)
